Design system

Style guide

Every component of the showcase, live, with the exact HTML and class names. Generators should use the Python helpers in tools/components.py; client-side code uses window.OC from site.js. See CONTRACT.md.

Color tokens

All colors are CSS custom properties on :root, redefined for dark mode. Never hard-code a color in a page; use a token or an outcome class. The six outcome colors are semantic and colorblind-safe: teal shades for support, slate for not supported, amber for inconclusive, hatched grey for not testable, and a dashed outline for hypotheses whose run never executed.

Typography

System fonts only: a serif for page and section headings and big numbers, a sans for everything else. Prose is limited to a 72-character measure with .prose. Numbers use tabular figures.

Headings and text

Kicker label

Section heading (h2, serif)

Subsection heading (h3, sans)

Lede paragraph: one or two plain sentences that say what the page shows.

Body text. Short sentences. Numbers come from the data files, for example 2,766 audited sentences. Inline code and a link.

Muted small text for notes and provenance.

HTML
<div class="sg-type">
<p class="kicker">Kicker label</p>
<h2 class="mt-0">Section heading (h2, serif)</h2>
<h3>Subsection heading (h3, sans)</h3>
<p class="lede">Lede paragraph: one or two plain sentences that say what the page shows.</p>
<p>Body text. Short sentences. Numbers come from the data files, for example <span class="num">2,766</span> audited sentences. Inline <code>code</code> and <a href="/campaign/">a link</a>.</p>
<p class="muted small">Muted small text for notes and provenance.</p>
</div>

Layout

Pages are built from full-width .section bands containing a .container (max 1200px plus gutters). Use .prose for reading text, .grid (with --2, --3, --4) for card grids, .split for text-beside-figure, and .stack / .cluster for vertical and inline spacing. .section--alt gives a tinted band. A page title block is <header class="page-head">.

One badge per verdict. Keys: supported, partial, not_supported, inconclusive, not_testable, not_run. Python: components.outcome_badge(key, short=False, count=None). JS: OC.badge(key, {short, count}).

Verdict definitions

Supported
The pre-registered decision rule was met.
Partially supported
Some parts of the decision rule were met, but not all.
Not supported
The test ran and the decision rule was not met.
Inconclusive
The test ran but was underpowered, ambiguous or confounded, so the data cannot settle it.
Not testable (data)
Not tested, or tested only through a proxy, because suitable data were unavailable or unsuitable.
Not tested (run did not execute)
Never tested: the run halted, failed technically or ran out of time or compute, or the hypothesis was proposed but never run.
HTML
<dl class="deflist"><div><dt><span class="badge badge--supported">Supported</span></dt><dd>The pre-registered decision rule was met.</dd></div><div><dt><span class="badge badge--partial">Partially supported</span></dt><dd>Some parts of the decision rule were met, but not all.</dd></div><div><dt><span class="badge badge--not_supported">Not supported</span></dt><dd>The test ran and the decision rule was not met.</dd></div><div><dt><span class="badge badge--inconclusive">Inconclusive</span></dt><dd>The test ran but was underpowered, ambiguous or confounded, so the data cannot settle it.</dd></div><div><dt><span class="badge badge--not_testable">Not testable (data)</span></dt><dd>Not tested, or tested only through a proxy, because suitable data were unavailable or unsuitable.</dd></div><div><dt><span class="badge badge--not_run">Not tested (run did not execute)</span></dt><dd>Never tested: the run halted, failed technically or ran out of time or compute, or the hypothesis was proposed but never run.</dd></div></dl>

Funnel

components.funnel([(label, value, note), ...]). Bar widths are relative to the first row. It is an ordered list, so screen readers read the stages in order with their numbers. Every row must be a subset of the row above; a count that is not (such as final reports) goes in a .funnel-aside next to it.

Campaign funnel

  1. Runs launched57
  2. Genuine runs16 were dry-run tests or superseded launches41
  3. Executed analyses32
  4. Completed at least one test27
  5. Completed the pipelinereached the multi-agent review stage17

23

runs produced a final research report, including some that stopped before review, so it is not a funnel step.

Inline SVG charts

Hand-built SVG uses .fill--KEY for outcome fills (.fill--not_testable uses the global hatch pattern), .chart-text / .chart-text--strong for labels and .chart-rule for gridlines. Give every chart role="img" plus a <title>, or a table, as its text equivalent. Do not add .figure img padding to SVGs.

components.figure(src, alt, caption_html, credit=True, note_html=""). Every figure needs real alt text. Manuscript figures carry the credit line Figure from the OmiCairn manuscript (in preparation). Use .figure__note for corrections. Figures sit on a light card in both themes because their artwork is drawn on white.

Figure

Callout

components.callout(kind, title, body_html) with note or caution. Use caution for limitations and corrections, note for definitions and context. Keep them short.

Note

How verdicts were assigned

AI adjudication agents applied each run's own pre-registered decision rule to its latest outputs.

A form.filter-bar with role="search". Toggle chips are button.chip with aria-pressed (set it from JS). Group chips in fieldset.filter-group with a legend. The result count is a live region. Keep filter state in the URL hash with OC.hash.

Filter bar

Outcome

15 of 179 hypotheses

<form class="filter-bar" role="search" aria-label="Filter hypotheses (example)" onsubmit="return false">
  <label class="search"><span class="visually-hidden">Search hypotheses</span>
    <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="M16 16l4.5 4.5"/></svg>
    <input class="input input--search" type="search" placeholder="Search hypotheses, genes, datasets">
  </label>
  <div class="filter-group"><label class="filter-group__label" for="sg-disease">Disease</label>
    <select class="select" id="sg-disease"><option>All diseases</option><option>Parkinson's disease</option><option>Alzheimer's disease</option><option>Cross-disease</option></select>
  </div>
  <fieldset class="filter-group"><legend>Outcome</legend><div class="chips"><button type="button" class="chip" aria-pressed="true" data-value="supported"><span class="swatch swatch--supported" aria-hidden="true"></span>Supported <span class="chip__count">15</span></button><button type="button" class="chip" aria-pressed="false" data-value="partial"><span class="swatch swatch--partial" aria-hidden="true"></span>Partial <span class="chip__count">7</span></button><button type="button" class="chip" aria-pressed="false" data-value="not_supported"><span class="swatch swatch--not_supported" aria-hidden="true"></span>Not supported <span class="chip__count">45</span></button><button type="button" class="chip" aria-pressed="false" data-value="inconclusive"><span class="swatch swatch--inconclusive" aria-hidden="true"></span>Inconclusive <span class="chip__count">31</span></button><button type="button" class="chip" aria-pressed="false" data-value="not_testable"><span class="swatch swatch--not_testable" aria-hidden="true"></span>Not testable <span class="chip__count">38</span></button><button type="button" class="chip" aria-pressed="false" data-value="not_run"><span class="swatch swatch--not_run" aria-hidden="true"></span>Not run <span class="chip__count">43</span></button></div></fieldset>
  <p class="filter-bar__count" aria-live="polite"><strong>15</strong> of 179 hypotheses</p>
</form>

Data table

Wrap tables in .table-wrap (horizontal scroll on small screens; give it tabindex="0", role="region" and a label). Numeric cells get .num. .data-table--compact tightens padding. Expandable rows: a button.row-toggle[data-oc-row-toggle] with aria-controls pointing at a tr.row-detail that starts hidden; site.js does the rest.

Disclosure

Native details.disclosure for optional depth (evidence quotes, adjudication notes, methods).

Disclosure

Adjudication note

Why the verdict differs from the run's own label, and any alternative reading.

Evidence quote

Verbatim excerpt from the run outputs.

HTML
<details class="disclosure">
  <summary>Adjudication note</summary>
  <div class="disclosure__body"><p>Why the verdict differs from the run's own label, and any alternative reading.</p></div>
</details>
<details class="disclosure">
  <summary>Evidence quote</summary>
  <div class="disclosure__body"><p>Verbatim excerpt from the run outputs.</p></div>
</details>

Steps

An ordered list for process strips such as the run-level phases.

Steps

  1. Pre-register

    Hypotheses and decision rules are fixed before analysis.

  2. Execute

    Code runs on public data; outputs are recorded.

  3. Cross-check

    A deterministic check compares claims with results.

  4. Review

    A claim-review agent and reviewer agents audit the report.

HTML
<ol class="steps">
  <li><p class="steps__title">Pre-register</p><p>Hypotheses and decision rules are fixed before analysis.</p></li>
  <li><p class="steps__title">Execute</p><p>Code runs on public data; outputs are recorded.</p></li>
  <li><p class="steps__title">Cross-check</p><p>A deterministic check compares claims with results.</p></li>
  <li><p class="steps__title">Review</p><p>A claim-review agent and reviewer agents audit the report.</p></li>
</ol>
